lieu: living room in Port-Bouet, Abidjan, at night, a man standing in front of an old TV showing a football match, sofa

persos.nom: the husband shouting at the TV
persos.desc: husband in his 40s, vintage orange Ivory Coast jersey, orange headband, arms in the air

persos.nom: the wife crocheting on the sofa
persos.desc: wife in her 40s, mauve wax dress, reading glasses, crocheting

dialogue: Penalty ! Penalty ! Arbitre-là est voleur !
Chéri, c'est match de 2012. Tu as enregistré ça.
Et il vole encore dêh !
jeu: The husband shouts at the TV. The wife answers calmly without looking up. The husband points at the screen, even angrier.
chute: The wife shakes her head and keeps crocheting. End on a close-up of the wife's exasperated face looking into the camera.

lieu: hospital consultation room in Cocody, Abidjan, white walls, examination bed, medicine cabinet

persos.nom: the nurse with the syringe
persos.desc: cheerful nurse in her 30s, white nurse uniform, cap with a red cross, holding a big syringe

persos.nom: the huge scared man
persos.desc: huge muscular man in his 30s, tight leopard-print tank top, tattoos, trembling like a child
persos.pose: hiding behind a tiny chair, terrified

dialogue: Mon gars, faut pas avoir peur dêh. Ça fait pas mal.
Toi-même pique-toi d'abord. Moi je regarde.
jeu: The nurse approaches gently. The huge man hides behind a tiny chair and points at her arm.
chute: The nurse takes one more step; the huge man faints dramatically onto the examination bed. End on a close-up of the nurse's amused face looking into the camera.

lieu: shared courtyard in Treichville, Abidjan, outdoor kitchen with a charcoal stove and pots, morning

persos.nom: the borrowing neighbor
persos.desc: neighbor in her 30s, hot-pink tracksuit, flip-flops, empty basket on her arm, big smile

persos.nom: the woman at the stove
persos.desc: woman in her 40s, navy-blue headwrap, ochre wax wrap skirt, wooden spoon

dialogue: Ma sœur, prête-moi marmite, riz et huile.
Et tu vas préparer où ?
Chez toi dêh. Mon gaz est fini.
jeu: The neighbor asks sweetly. The woman frowns. The neighbor answers as if it were obvious.
chute: The neighbor sits down on the stool at the stove and starts fanning the charcoal. End on a close-up of the woman's speechless face looking into the camera.

lieu: lagoon promenade at night in Marcory, Abidjan, full moon over the Ebrie lagoon, city lights

persos.nom: the romantic boyfriend
persos.desc: romantic young man in his 20s, sequined gold jacket, pointing at the moon
persos.pose: kneeling dramatically, pointing at the moon

persos.nom: the practical girlfriend
persos.desc: practical young woman in her 20s, black leather jacket, short pixie haircut

dialogue: Bébé, pour toi, je vais décrocher la lune dêh !
Commence par décrocher mon transport.
jeu: The boyfriend declares his love dramatically. The girlfriend answers flatly.
chute: The boyfriend slowly checks his empty pockets, then looks back up at the moon. End on a close-up of the girlfriend's unimpressed face looking into the camera.

lieu: dusty road in Abobo, Abidjan, hot sun, a puddle of muddy water on the roadside, cars passing

persos.nom: the sweating boy
persos.desc: chubby boy around 9, shaved head, lime-green t-shirt, navy shorts, heavy backpack

persos.nom: the proud father in the fedora
persos.desc: thin father in his 40s, short-sleeve white shirt and tie, brown fedora hat, briefcase

dialogue: Papa, pourquoi on n'a pas voiture ?
Pour ta santé, mon fils. On fait sport.
Tu vois ? Même douche est gratuite dêh !
jeu: The boy complains. The father answers proudly. A taxi drives through the puddle and splashes them both with muddy water. The father wipes his face and smiles.
chute: End on a close-up of the boy's dripping, deadpan face looking into the camera.

lieu: small tailor shop in Adjame, Abidjan, sewing machine, colorful fabric rolls, half-finished dresses on mannequins

persos.nom: the lady in the silver lace boubou
persos.desc: elegant lady in her 40s, silver-grey lace boubou with matching headwrap, sunglasses on her head

persos.nom: the relaxed tailor
persos.desc: relaxed tailor in his 50s, tape measure around his neck, pencil behind his ear, round spectacles on the tip of his nose, sky-blue kaftan

dialogue: Couturier, ma robe devait être prête depuis un mois dêh !
Elle est prête, Tantie. C'est tissu qui n'est pas arrivé.
jeu: The lady scolds the tailor. He keeps sewing calmly and answers with a reassuring smile.
chute: The tailor proudly holds up an empty hanger. End on a close-up of the lady's furious face looking into the camera.

lieu: wedding reception buffet in Cocody, Abidjan, long table with big dishes of rice, chicken, attieke and alloco

persos.nom: the aunt with the hand fan
persos.desc: aunt in her 50s, champagne-colored lace dress with matching headwrap, hand fan
persos.pose: pointing at his plate with her fan

persos.nom: the uncle with the huge plate
persos.desc: uncle in his 60s, bright royal-blue boubou, holding a plate piled very high with food

dialogue: Tonton, c'est ta cinquième assiette dêh !
Non ma fille, c'est même assiette-là. Je remplis seulement.
jeu: The aunt points at his plate. The uncle keeps adding food and answers innocently.
chute: The uncle pulls a plastic bag out of his boubou and fills it with chicken too. End on a close-up of the aunt's shocked face looking into the camera.

lieu: moto-taxi speeding on a road in Abobo, Abidjan, dust clouds, motion blur

persos.nom: the terrified passenger
persos.desc: passenger in her 40s, office dress with an orange-and-purple geometric print, headwrap flying in the wind

persos.nom: the moto driver with the goggles
persos.desc: moto-taxi driver in his 20s, yellow vest, helmet with aviator goggles, eyes closed
persos.pose: driving with his eyes closed, relaxed smile

dialogue: Doucement, mon fils ! Tu roules trop vite !
Tantie, ferme les yeux comme moi. Tu vas plus avoir peur.
jeu: The passenger screams. The driver answers calmly with his eyes closed.
chute: The passenger realizes his eyes are closed and screams even louder. End on a close-up of the passenger's terrified face looking into the camera.

lieu: living room in Yopougon, Abidjan, a teacher's note on the coffee table, a father in an armchair

persos.nom: the boy with the note
persos.desc: boy around 10, school uniform, big round glasses, holding the teacher's note

persos.nom: the proud father in the armchair
persos.desc: father in his 40s, green-and-white striped polo, thin goatee, proud smile
persos.pose: sitting proudly in the armchair, arms crossed

dialogue: Papa, le devoir que tu as fait pour moi-là…
Oui ? C'est vingt sur vingt ?
Maître dit que tu redoubles dêh.
jeu: The boy announces with embarrassment. The father smiles proudly, then freezes.
chute: The father's proud smile melts and he slowly hides behind a cushion. End on a close-up of the boy's apologetic face looking into the camera.

lieu: early morning in a courtyard in Abobo, Abidjan, a rooster on a wall, sunrise

persos.nom: the sleepy neighbor with the pillow
persos.desc: sleepy neighbor in his 30s, plaid flannel pyjamas, sleep mask on his forehead, pillow in hand

persos.nom: the rooster owner
persos.desc: rooster owner in his 60s, bald, thick black-rimmed glasses, terracotta kaftan

dialogue: Vieux père, ton coq me réveille chaque matin !
Normal. C'est seul dans quartier-là qui a travail.
jeu: The neighbor complains. The owner pets his rooster proudly and answers.
chute: The rooster crows loudly right in the neighbor's face. End on a close-up of the neighbor's furious face looking into the camera.

lieu: clothing boutique in Cocody, Abidjan, mirrors, racks of dresses

persos.nom: the wife in the emerald gown
persos.desc: wife in her 30s, natural afro, trying on a sparkling emerald evening gown with a big price tag
persos.pose: twirling in front of the mirror

persos.nom: the husband with the price tag
persos.desc: husband in his 30s, white linen shirt, holding the price tag, sweating
persos.pose: reading the price tag, eyes wide

dialogue: Chéri, robe-là me va bien, hein ?
Elle te va… mais elle ne va pas à mon salaire dêh.
jeu: The wife twirls happily. The husband reads the price tag and answers carefully.
chute: The husband quietly hangs a much cheaper dress next to her. End on a close-up of the wife's offended face looking into the camera.

lieu: small mobile money kiosk on a street corner in Abobo, Abidjan, yellow umbrella, phone credit posters

persos.nom: the young agent with two phones
persos.desc: young agent in her 20s, braided bob, bright yellow-and-green uniform shirt, two phones in front of her

persos.nom: the old man with the cash
persos.desc: old man in his 70s, white boubou, red fez hat, holding banknotes

dialogue: Ma fille, envoie cinq mille à ma femme au village dêh.
Son numéro, Tonton ?
Faut pas fatiguer. Elle va reconnaître son l'argent.
jeu: The old man hands over the money proudly. The agent asks for the number. He answers with total confidence.
chute: The agent stares at him, then slowly pushes the money back. End on a close-up of the agent's speechless face looking into the camera.

lieu: lagoon promenade of the Plateau at sunset, Abidjan skyline, palm trees

persos.nom: the girl in the red sun hat
persos.desc: young woman in her 20s, flowing white summer dress, huge red sun hat

persos.nom: the boyfriend with the phone
persos.desc: young man in his 20s, pastel-pink shirt, holding a phone to take a photo
persos.pose: walking around her with the phone, searching

dialogue: Bébé, prends mon meilleur côté dêh !
Je cherche encore, attends.
jeu: The girl poses dramatically. The boyfriend keeps walking around her with the phone, searching from every angle.
chute: The boyfriend lies on the ground, then climbs on a bench, still searching for an angle. End on a close-up of the girl's offended face looking into the camera.

lieu: town hall wedding room in Abidjan, flags, a desk with a big register, rows of guests

persos.nom: the mayor with the sash
persos.desc: mayor in his 60s, dark suit with an orange-white-green sash, reading glasses on a chain

persos.nom: the nervous groom
persos.desc: nervous groom in his 30s, ivory tuxedo, bow tie, sweating

persos.nom: the huge mother-in-law in the front row
persos.desc: huge mother-in-law in her 60s, giant fuchsia headwrap, judging stare
persos.pose: sitting in the front row, arms crossed

dialogue: Monsieur, acceptez-vous de prendre Madame pour épouse ?
Euh… Sa maman est comprise dans paquet-là ?
jeu: The mayor asks solemnly. The groom glances at the scary mother-in-law and asks his question timidly.
chute: The mother-in-law slowly stands up and cracks her knuckles. End on a close-up of the groom's terrified face looking into the camera.

lieu: street corner in Treichville, Abidjan, two friends in front of a kiosk, motorbikes passing

persos.nom: the friend in the zebra shirt
persos.desc: flashy young man in his 20s, zebra-print shirt, white sunglasses

persos.nom: the suspicious friend in the grey hoodie
persos.desc: young man in his 20s, grey hoodie, hands in his pockets

dialogue: Mon vieux, prête-moi dix mille. Je rembourse lundi.
Quel lundi ?
Choisis. Y en a beaucoup dêh.
jeu: The friend asks with confidence. The other raises an eyebrow. The first spreads his arms generously.
chute: The suspicious friend turns and walks away; the first one follows him, still holding out his hand. End on a close-up of the suspicious friend rolling his eyes at the camera.

lieu: village courtyard near Abidjan, mud-brick house, a well far in the background, baobab tree

persos.nom: the nephew from Abidjan
persos.desc: nephew in his 20s, sunglasses, tight skinny jeans, white sneakers, phone in hand

persos.nom: the grandmother with the bucket
persos.desc: strong grandmother in her 70s, simple brown pagne, headscarf, carrying a big bucket
persos.pose: handing him the big empty bucket

dialogue: Mamie, à Abidjan on a eau courante dêh !
Ici aussi. Tu prends seau et tu cours au puits.
jeu: The nephew brags. The grandmother hands him the bucket and points at the well far away.
chute: The nephew looks at the far-away well, then starts running with the bucket. End on a close-up of the grandmother's satisfied face looking into the camera.

lieu: street barbershop in Koumassi, Abidjan, plastic chair, mirror, hair clippings on the floor

persos.nom: the bald client
persos.desc: completely bald man in his 50s, shiny head, thick eyebrows, striped barber cape

persos.nom: the young barber with the durag
persos.desc: young barber in his 20s, purple durag, comb and clippers in hands
persos.pose: looking at the bald head, confused

dialogue: Petit, fais-moi bon dégradé !
Tonton, y a plus rien à dégrader dêh.
jeu: The bald client asks proudly. The barber searches for hair with his comb, then answers.
chute: The barber polishes the bald head with a cloth until it shines like a mirror. End on a close-up of the client's proud face looking into the camera.

lieu: cozy bedroom in Yopougon, Abidjan, colorful bedspread, wall calendar with the 25th circled in red

persos.nom: the wife in the satin pyjamas
persos.desc: young wife in her late 20s, cream satin pyjamas with little hearts, two long braids
persos.pose: cuddling her husband's arm, batting her eyelashes

persos.nom: the husband with the empty wallet
persos.desc: husband in his 30s, burnt-orange t-shirt, thick-rimmed glasses, holding an empty open wallet

dialogue: Chéri, tu m'aimes combien ?
Bébé, on parle pas chiffres le 25 du mois dêh.
Et le 30 ?
Le 30, je t'aime gratuit.
jeu: The wife asks sweetly. The husband points nervously at the calendar. She insists; he answers proudly.
chute: The wife pushes him off the bed. End on a close-up of the husband's face on the floor looking into the camera.

lieu: busy open-air fish market at the port of Abidjan, wooden stalls, fish on ice, seagulls, morning

persos.nom: the customer in the dashiki
persos.desc: skinny customer in his 30s, orange-and-black dashiki shirt
persos.pose: leaning forward sniffing the fish suspiciously

persos.nom: the fish seller with the gold tooth
persos.desc: large cheerful fish seller in her 50s, plum wax dress with matching headwrap, gold tooth
persos.pose: proudly holding up a big silver fish with both hands

dialogue: Tantie, ton poisson-là est frais vraiment ?
Frais ? Ce matin même, il m'a dit bonjour dêh !
jeu: The customer sniffs the fish suspiciously. The fish seller shakes the fish proudly as she answers.
chute: A swarm of flies buzzes around the fish. End on a close-up of the customer's disgusted face looking into the camera.

lieu: shared courtyard in Koumassi, Abidjan, father and son on a bench, a small grocery shop across the street

persos.nom: the son in love
persos.desc: teenage son around 17, heart-shaped sunglasses, red bomber jacket
persos.pose: announcing dreamily, hands on his heart

persos.nom: the calculating father
persos.desc: father in his 50s, brown leather cap, checkered blue kaftan

dialogue: Papa, je suis amoureux de la fille du boutiquier dêh.
Mon fils ! Marie-la vite. On aura crédit chez eux !
jeu: The son announces dreamily. The father calculates on his fingers, delighted, and hugs his son.
chute: The father pulls a long shopping list out of his pocket and kisses it. End on a close-up of the son's confused face looking into the camera.

lieu: outdoor terrace of a cafe in Deux-Plateaux, Abidjan, two cups of coffee, evening

persos.nom: the girlfriend with the gold cuffs
persos.desc: young woman in her 20s, long knotless braids with gold cuffs, white off-shoulder top, phone in hand

persos.nom: the boyfriend in the olive bomber
persos.desc: young man in his 20s, olive bomber jacket, small mustache, holding a coffee cup

dialogue: Chéri, mon papa veut te voir dêh.
Dis-lui que je suis en voyage.
Jusqu'à quand ?
Jusqu'à la fin de ma vie.
jeu: The girlfriend announces excitedly. The boyfriend chokes on his coffee and answers.
chute: The boyfriend puts on sunglasses and slowly slides under the table. End on a close-up of the girlfriend's annoyed face looking into the camera.

lieu: shared courtyard in Treichville, Abidjan, laundry line with wax cloths drying in the sun

persos.nom: the woman in the white t-shirt
persos.desc: woman in her 30s, plain white t-shirt, long denim skirt, hair in a messy bun
persos.pose: pointing at the empty laundry line, angry

persos.nom: the neighbor wearing the pagne
persos.desc: neighbor in her 30s, wearing a bright orange-and-blue wax wrap dress, big sunglasses
persos.pose: showing off her outfit proudly with one hand on her hip

dialogue: Qui a pris mon pagne sur la corde, hein ?!
Ma sœur, ton pagne-là me cherchait.
jeu: The woman shouts. The neighbor turns around like a model, showing off the pagne.
chute: The neighbor does a model twirl and walks away like on a catwalk. End on a close-up of the woman's furious face looking into the camera.

lieu: family courtyard in Abobo, Abidjan, relatives on plastic chairs listening to an uncle, sunset

persos.nom: the bragging uncle
persos.desc: bragging uncle in his 50s, thick winter leather jacket in the heat, Paris scarf, sweating

persos.nom: the nephew with the braces
persos.desc: nephew around 15, braces on his teeth, zooming on a photo on his phone, smirking

dialogue: À Paris, je mangeais au restaurant chaque jour dêh !
Tonton, sur la photo-là, tu fais vaisselle.
jeu: The uncle brags. The nephew zooms on a photo and answers.
chute: The nephew turns the phone to the family: it shows the uncle washing a mountain of dishes. End on a close-up of the uncle's embarrassed face looking into the camera.

lieu: tontine meeting in a courtyard in Koumassi, Abidjan, women in a circle on plastic chairs, a cash box in the middle

persos.nom: the tontine president
persos.desc: tontine president in her 50s, navy-and-white wax dress, red reading glasses, big notebook

persos.nom: the woman chewing gum
persos.desc: woman in her 30s, gold sequined headwrap, big earrings, chewing gum

dialogue: Ma sœur, c'est ton tour de cotiser dêh !
Moi je suis dans tontine pour recevoir seulement.
jeu: The president reminds her. The woman answers calmly, chewing her gum.
chute: The other women in the circle gasp and slowly turn their heads toward her. End on a close-up of the president's outraged face looking into the camera.

lieu: bedroom in Riviera, Abidjan, birthday balloons, a birthday cake on a table

persos.nom: the birthday girl
persos.desc: young woman in her 20s, sparkly sea-green party dress, birthday crown, eyes closed

persos.nom: the broke boyfriend
persos.desc: young man in his 20s, rainbow suspenders over a black shirt, empty hands, nervous smile
persos.pose: standing in front of her with empty hands

dialogue: Chéri, pour mon anniversaire, je veux gros téléphone dêh !
Ferme les yeux.
Maintenant… imagine.
jeu: The girl asks excitedly and closes her eyes. The boyfriend waves his empty hands in front of her and whispers.
chute: The girl opens her eyes and sees his empty hands. End on a close-up of the girl's furious face looking into the camera.

lieu: small neighborhood shop in Yopougon, Abidjan, shelves of rice, oil and sugar, a thick credit notebook on the counter

persos.nom: the shopkeeper in the green apron
persos.desc: shopkeeper in his 40s, round belly, bright green apron with pockets, pen behind his ear, huge credit notebook
persos.pose: slamming the notebook on the counter

persos.nom: the customer in the camouflage t-shirt
persos.desc: grown man in his 30s with a short beard, camouflage t-shirt, carrying a big bag of rice on his shoulder

dialogue: Mon gars, tu me dois déjà vingt mille dêh !
Note encore, Tonton. Ton cahier est épais.
jeu: The shopkeeper slams the notebook. The customer taps it encouragingly.
chute: The customer walks away with the rice, waving goodbye. End on a close-up of the shopkeeper's speechless face looking into the camera.

lieu: small living room in Abobo, Abidjan, Valentine's Day decorations, paper hearts, candles

persos.nom: the girlfriend with the heart balloon
persos.desc: young woman in her 20s, red velvet dress, heart-shaped earrings, holding a heart balloon

persos.nom: the boyfriend with the flashlight
persos.desc: young man in his 20s, black turtleneck, holding a big flashlight with a red ribbon

dialogue: Bébé, pour Saint-Valentin, je veux quelque chose qui brille !
Tiens. Avec délestage-là, tu vas me remercier dêh.
jeu: The girlfriend asks excitedly. The boyfriend hands her the flashlight with the ribbon, very proud.
chute: The lights go out in the whole room and he switches on the flashlight under his chin with a proud smile. End on a close-up of the girlfriend's face lit by the flashlight, looking into the camera.

lieu: living room in Marcory, Abidjan, family meeting before a wedding, sofa and armchairs, a plate of cake on the table

persos.nom: the bride's mother with the gold necklace
persos.desc: bride's mother in her 50s, elegant cobalt-blue boubou, heavy gold necklace

persos.nom: the future son-in-law
persos.desc: future son-in-law in his 30s, olive safari suit, thin gold-rimmed glasses, relaxed smile

dialogue: Mon fils, ma fille ne sait pas cuisiner dêh.
Ya fohi, Tantie. Moi aussi, je ne sais pas payer.
jeu: The mother confesses with embarrassment. The future son-in-law answers with a relaxed smile and a thumbs-up.
chute: The mother slowly pulls back the plate of cake she was offering him. End on a close-up of the mother's shocked face looking into the camera.

lieu: festive wedding courtyard in Bingerville, decorated white tent, rows of plastic chairs, gift table with wrapped boxes

persos.nom: the aunt with the gift notebook
persos.desc: imposing aunt in her 50s, shiny bronze boubou, giant headwrap, notebook and pen

persos.nom: the guest in the metallic-green suit
persos.desc: slim guest in his 30s, shiny metallic-green suit, empty hands, big smile

dialogue: Mon fils, tu as apporté quel cadeau ?
Ma présence, Tantie. Transport est cher dêh !
Ah bon ? Toi, tu vas t'asseoir là-bas, hein ?
jeu: The aunt asks, pen ready. The guest spreads his empty arms with a big smile.
chute: The aunt writes in her notebook and points him to the very last chair at the back, far from the food. End on a close-up of the guest's disappointed face looking into the camera.
